replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Guys, I am sure that ivy is going to code like crazy and make everything awesome really really soon . The dev teams have so much planned that Avicus will be the light of the online server world. The developer is going to find so so much more time soon, he is just waiting for now. The best thing for us to do is wait and not expect anything at all. Don't worry about why player counts are low, the reasons don't matter, don't worry about the hubs being down for days, that is nothing, heck we were down for months, and we still have about 100 players playing these days.  Don't worry about 1.8 clients, 1.7 is awesome. Just tell your friends that 1.7 is the best. I feel that we are going to have like 8 new game modes, updated kits and bug fixes on all our current game modes, and 400-500 more players very soon, it's going to be fantastic. We just got to wait about a year or two . We just got to be patient and understanding .
